newsitem.title: USA: Apple names Austin VP and GM of Imaging Division.
newsitem.headline: Apple names Austin VP and GM of Imaging Division.

text.p: Apple Computer Inc Thursday named Maury Austin to the post of vice president and general manager of its Imaging Division, effective immediately.

In a statement, the company said Austin will report directly to Marco Landi, executive vice president and chief operating officer, and will have profit and loss responsibilities for Apple's Imaging Division, including all of the Imaging Engineering, Marketing, and Sales resources. Apple's Imaging Division covers Printers, Digital Cameras, and Color Scanners.
Austin most recently served as the Director of Business Development and Printer Supplies for the Division.
